name: Box / refrigerated-space temperature
measurement_location: Representative refrigerated-space temperature; use where the application defines evaporator TD from box temperature.

name: Evaporator outlet pressure
measurement_location: At or near the evaporator outlet / TXV bulb region when a pressure access point is available.

name: Evaporator outlet suction-line temperature
measurement_location: At or near the evaporator outlet / TXV bulb location.

name: Compressor suction pressure
measurement_location: At the compressor suction service point.

name: Compressor discharge pressure
measurement_location: At the compressor discharge / high-side service point.

name: Compressor discharge-line temperature
measurement_location: On the discharge line near the compressor outlet when required.

name: Condenser outlet pressure
measurement_location: At or representative of the condenser outlet / liquid-line high-side pressure when an access point is available.

name: Condenser outlet liquid-line temperature
measurement_location: On the liquid line at the condenser outlet.

name: Metering-device inlet pressure
measurement_location: Immediately upstream of the metering device when a pressure access point is available.

name: Metering-device inlet liquid temperature
measurement_location: Immediately upstream of the metering device.

name: Condenser entering-air temperature
measurement_location: Air actually entering the condenser coil.

name: Airflow
measurement_location: Measured or established airflow through the relevant coil.
